classDiagram
direction LR
class FrozenSnapshotLoader {
  <<compiler>>
  +load(FrozenRunSnapshotV1) PlanReadyV1
  +query(NodeId) NodeDescriptorV1
}
class GraphScheduler {
  <<state machine>>
  +apply(NodeOutcomeV1) TransitionProposalV1
  +quiesce(ControlScopeV1) CheckpointProposalV1
}
class NodeExecutorRegistry {
  <<typed registry>>
  +execute(NodeInputEnvelopeV1) NodeOutcomeV1
}
class ContextRevisionPort {
  <<immutable revision DAG>>
  +revise(ContextPatchV1) RevisionId
  +fork(ForkContextV1) RevisionSetV1
  +reconcile(JoinReconciliationV1) RevisionId
  +project(ContextSelectionV1) ContextProjectionV1
}
class BranchJoinCoordinator {
  <<structured concurrency>>
  +open(BranchRegionV1) BranchAdmissionV1
  +arrive(BranchOutcomeV1) JoinReadyV1
}
class LimitController {
  <<hierarchical ledger>>
  +admit(LimitRequestV1) LimitDecisionV1
  +charge(UsageV1) RemainingBudgetV1
}
class RouteEvaluator {
  <<pure rules>>
  +classify(ContextProjectionV1) ClassificationV1
  +select(ClassificationV1) RouteSelectionV1
}
class ModelAgentRuntime {
  <<Aworkit orchestration>>
  +model(ModelNodeInputV1) ModelNodeOutcomeV1
  +agent(AgentNodeInputV1) AgentNodeOutcomeV1
}
class SubagentRuntime {
  <<child lifecycle>>
  +spawn(ChildContextSpecV1) ChildStartedV1
  +integrate(ChildResultV1) IntegrationOutcomeV1
}
class AttemptPolicy {
  <<pure decision>>
  +decide(ExecutionOutcomeV1) AttemptDecisionV1
}
class SuspensionController {
  <<state machine>>
  +suspend(SuspensionReasonV1) SuspensionProposalV1
  +resume(InputOrControlV1) ResumeActionV1
}
class TrustedCoreGateway {
  <<process boundary>>
  +receive(WorkerControlEnvelopeV1) void
  +propose(WorkerProposalEnvelopeV1) void
  +invoke(InvocationProposalV1) void
}
class CheckpointRehydrator {
  <<pure recovery>>
  +checkpoint() WorkerCheckpointV1
  +restore(RehydrationEnvelopeV1) RehydrationResultV1
}
class FrozenRunSnapshotV1 {
  <<immutable Aworkit DTO>>
  +snapshotId
  +snapshotHash
  +authorityManifestRef
  +resolvedBindings
}
class ContextRevisionV1 {
  <<Aworkit DTO>>
  +revisionId
  +parents
  +lineage
  +typedLayers
}
class InvocationProposalV1 {
  <<Aworkit DTO>>
  +invocationId
  +nodeId
  +attemptId
  +authorityRef
  +budgetRef
}
class WorkerCheckpointV1 {
  <<Aworkit DTO>>
  +snapshotHash
  +committedCursor
  +executionFrontier
  +contextHeads
}
FrozenSnapshotLoader --> FrozenRunSnapshotV1 : verifies and compiles
FrozenSnapshotLoader --> GraphScheduler : immutable plan
GraphScheduler --> NodeExecutorRegistry : typed dispatch
GraphScheduler --> ContextRevisionPort : revise by explicit ID
GraphScheduler --> BranchJoinCoordinator : fork and join regions
GraphScheduler --> LimitController : admission before work
GraphScheduler --> RouteEvaluator : frozen route choice
GraphScheduler --> AttemptPolicy : normalized outcome
GraphScheduler --> SuspensionController : exact frontier
NodeExecutorRegistry --> ModelAgentRuntime : Model and Agent nodes
NodeExecutorRegistry --> SubagentRuntime : Subagent nodes
NodeExecutorRegistry --> TrustedCoreGateway : brokered action nodes
ModelAgentRuntime --> TrustedCoreGateway : model and internal tool proposals
ModelAgentRuntime --> ContextRevisionPort : selected projection and result
SubagentRuntime --> ContextRevisionPort : child fork and integration
BranchJoinCoordinator --> ContextRevisionPort : explicit reconciliation
ContextRevisionPort --> ContextRevisionV1 : creates
TrustedCoreGateway --> InvocationProposalV1 : sends to core broker
CheckpointRehydrator --> WorkerCheckpointV1 : proposes Aworkit state
CheckpointRehydrator --> FrozenSnapshotLoader : exact snapshot fingerprint
CheckpointRehydrator --> GraphScheduler : restore committed frontier
Note for ModelAgentRuntime "Rig is a replaceable private adapter and never a persisted contract"
